node.statement: On the guarded positive deployed 433-1b role-cell-3 branch, every case with missing df record xi=3 and pairing index in {4,5,9,12} is empty across all source and target signs. For pairings 4 and 5, the even opposite-DE quartic and the second paired equation give an exact quadratic parity-x resultant of degree eight in f. Exchange of the two identical positive de records transports pairings 4 and 5 value-for-value to pairings 9 and 12. There is no witness, boundary, free-gcd, or unresolved stratum. This completes xi=3 but claims no other missing role, cell closure, or Prize result.
